Name: Victorian Mailbox - OUTDATED
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Change your dull-looking mailbox into something more fancy.
Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS OR MODDROP. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S
MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
______________

Hello! Just a small mod I put together. To install, overwrite the xnb files in the Content and Maps folders. 
I've added a compatibility version for all the versions of my two map mods: [A New Map Recolour](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/599/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D599%26preview%3D&pUp=1) and [Medieval Map Recolour](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/466/?).
That was a huge B to make.
(NB: I still need to make a Winter recolour for the 'A New Map Recolour' mod, so that's why the file uses the vanilla xnb right now).

Please don't redistribute.
